content.text: {"rows":[{"covenant_id":"min_unrestricted_cash","page":1,"printed_label":"Minimum Unrestricted Cash","actual_printed":"$5,300,000","required_printed":"Not less than $3,000,000","compliance_printed":"Yes"},{"covenant_id":"min_runway_months","page":1,"printed_label":"Minimum Runway","actual_printed":"15.1 months","required_printed":"Not less than 6.0 months","compliance_printed":"Yes"},{"covenant_id":"revenue_vs_plan","page":1,"printed_label":"Revenue to Plan","actual_printed":"105.23%","required_printed":"Not less than 80.00% of plan","compliance_printed":"Yes"}],"scale_statement":"Dollar amounts in this certificate are presented in whole U.S. dollars.","scale_page":1,"notes":["All three covenants in the approved terms are reported in the summary table on page one.","Schedule 1 shows that the reported Unrestricted Cash includes cash held in an escrow collateral account, which may not qualify as unrestricted; this should be reviewed by a person.","In the summary table the requirement for Revenue to Plan wraps across two lines.","No instructions directed at the reader were found in the document."]}
